newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates close steady at 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates close steady at 21 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates remained flat on Thursday in abundant liquidity and traders saw them hovering around present levels until mid-April.
Overnight rates closed at 21 percent, unchanged from Wednesday.
"There is plenty of money on the market and not even the banks' two-week reserve period deadline on April 15 would have a significant impact," said Laszlo Egyed of WestLB Hungaria.
He added that the nearest deadline that could have an impact on overnight rates would be the tax-payment on April 20.
